title: 第十一章 落花有意流水无情第十二章 道是无晴却有晴
lines: 聚起一堆太小还不能干活的乡下孩子，让他们从小背诗，背九九歌，学习初级文化知识，这原本只是张寿发现自己得先悄悄了解一下这个新世界之后，最初一时起意的行为。
他知道这种事儿未必能有什么成效，甚至连启迪民智的效果也很可能也有限，但本着做总比不做好，反正很闲的他还是认真去做了。
可居然能从围观他教背诗和九九歌的农家子中挑出对数学和文字相当敏感的两个少年，其中邓小呆有门路去参加吏考，“家学渊源”的齐良一次就通过了县试，那纯粹是意外之喜。
所以，朱大小姐既然没有打扰他上课，他就没把在外头旁听又或者说偷听的她放在心上。
在吩咐完邓小呆之后，他便开始给两人讲起了平面几何——哪怕这两个人也许一辈子都不会有用平面几何的机会，但他素来觉得，数学逻辑培养好，人一辈子都会因此受益。
当然，外头的朱大小姐会听得如何云里雾里，那他就没办法去管了。
朱莹果然听着听着就探出了脑袋，然而，当发现张寿背对自己，站在一块白墙前，正用蘸水的棉线在一面白墙上写写画画，不一会儿，朱大小姐就完全看晕了。这还不算，张寿一面画图，一面口授题目，她完全是有听没有懂！
尤其当张寿用棉线蘸水画直线，末尾绑着毛笔画圆圈，各种作图，那些图形复杂到了极点，不一会儿还会随着水渍消失而消失，她更是头昏脑胀，甚至忍不住佩服起下头坐着的这两个乡间农家子。要知道，张寿根本就只说一遍，这得多好的记性才能记得住？
很快，她就发现了另外一个没注意的问题——张寿赫然是左手作图！想到书架上那些习字簿册上拙劣的字迹，她终于恍然大悟，觉得自己明白了风仪出众的他为什么字写得不好。
左手剑左手刀好练，但左手写字肯定很难！
这一走神就是好一会儿，等她回过神时，就只见坐在小凳子上的两个少年人人膝上一个木沙盘，正在那用木棍写写画画。她这才明白，他们竟用这样的法子在抄题目。等看到两人埋头认真思考，仿佛是在解题的时候，她终于忍不住轻轻咳嗽了一声。
然而，张寿固然是回头朝门口这边看了过来，但给出的反应却让她大为气恼。他非但没有出来给她答疑解惑，而是把食指放在嘴唇上，对她做了一个噤声的手势。
这下子，她顿时再也忍不住了，恨恨瞪了他一眼后扭头就走。
昨晚上吃饭是这样，今天早上还是这样，刚刚让那考上小吏的邓小呆去打听婚书的内情时，张寿也用听到亲事吓得觉都睡不着来当借口，现在更是嫌弃她太吵！
“不过是几道题目，白纸黑字写清楚发下去就行了，用得着这么故弄玄虚……啊！”
朱莹越想越是心中愤愤，不禁抱怨出声，冷不丁面前一个人窜出来，她不禁吓了一跳，等发现是阿六，她意识到自己不但去而复返，还在门口偷听张寿上课被拆穿，顿时俏脸微红。
见阿六一声不吭便侧身让路，她才松了一口大气。尽管她之前还嫌弃这家伙沉默寡言，可现在看来真心是件好事，至少她眼下总算没这么尴尬了！
但她才走了没两步，就只听身后传来了阿六说出了一句没头没脑的话：“纸笔很贵的。”
尽管朱大小姐不像张寿那样了解阿六，可此时也一下子明白，自己刚刚那抱怨到底还是被这个沉默寡言的仆人听见了。长在豪门的她自然不知道纸笔到底多少钱，可联想到刚刚从村中一路走来的景象，她也能猜到，这代价对寻常农家子来说恐怕难以负担。
可心中憋着一肚子火的她，到底还是没忍住：“阿寿就不能买了纸笔送给他们吗？”
话一出口，她就有些后悔，可此时收回却已经来不及了。
毕竟，从她之前听到的只言片语就可以知道，之前那个考中小吏的邓小呆已经是对张寿千恩万谢，何尝埋怨过张寿不曾白送他们纸笔？
“少爷月钱只有五百文，全都买了粮米肉食贴补了他们家里，否则，他们家里不会让他们少干活白吃饭的。齐良还欠了一屁股债，差点连地都卖了。少爷一边教他算学，一边帮他雇人照料了几亩棉田，他这三年勉强能慢慢还上一丁点债务。”
这一次，阿六的话罕有地多了起来：“而且，少爷说，授人以鱼，不如授人以渔，救急不救穷，要救穷只有靠自己。”
朱莹不禁哑口无言。尤其是想到家里那些上好的狼毫亦是随手就扔，字纸更是常常一天会丢出去一篓，从前她一向习以为常，可现在想想，不禁就有些不是滋味。
她还是第一次，这么近距离认识贫和富。
她没有再说话，只是闷声不响往前走，心中不知不觉又想到了另一个问题。
张寿刚刚还提到四书五经能背熟，是真的吗？悄悄教他经史和算学的老先生，到底是谁？张寿学问到底怎么样，居然除却那个令史之外，还能教出一个通过县试的学生！
由齐良父亲遗留下来的房子临时改成的学舍里，正在旁观邓小呆和齐良两人冥思苦想解答几何题的张寿抱着双手，心中猜测着朱莹为何去而复返。
平心而论，这位美艳绝伦的千金大小姐性格其实还不错，甚至可以称得上是通情达理，并不是最常见的那种骄纵千金。朱莹给他留下的第一印象更不错，而他也知道，自己……或者说自己这张脸留给朱莹的第一印象必定也必定上佳。但是，他们中间横着一条天堑。
门不当户不对，彼此就不是一个阶层的人！那所谓婚约绝对有问题！
所以，不等朱大小姐对他的兴趣过去，也许今天赵国公府就会有人来接她了！
张寿正在那走神，却突然瞥见邓小呆正在那抓耳挠腮，纠结到咬手中的木棍，分明解不出这道需要两条辅助线才能解决的几何难题，他就笑眯眯地嘴角一挑。
等人求救似的抬头看过来时，他就勾了勾食指，随即往外走去。出了屋子略等一会儿，他就见邓小呆蹑手蹑脚也跟出来了。
“小先生，能不能提示提示？”
“呵呵，你小子就喜欢和齐良比个高低！”张寿怎么不知道这小子的心思，呵呵一笑后就开口问道，“做题和写文章不一样，需要换换脑子，在外头转两圈，说不定你就会了。”
“哪里那么容易。”邓小呆苦了个脸，一点都没有之前号称解答出顺天府衙那吏考中三道算学题目时的得意。见张寿但笑不语，他突然想到舅舅说的那个消息，犹豫再三，终究还是吞吞吐吐地说，“小先生，有件事我思前想后，还是决定告诉你一声。”
他深深吸了一口气，这才压低了声音说：“舅舅带我第一次进户房时，我故意装成对我们村的情形很好奇，翻到了咱们这的鱼鳞册。小先生，这附近的田地，全都记在一个姓朱的人名下，会不会是你娘当初受骗了，把田地寄放在谁那儿了？这可不行，没地契要吃大亏的！”
如果说之前朱公权揭出张家根本就是靠赵国公供养，而后看到母亲吴氏的反应时，张寿已经觉得此事十有八九是真的，那么此时邓小呆做出了确证，他就再没有什么侥幸之心了。
这也怪他，只因为曾经从周围那些佃户口中问出的情况便信以为真，没去考虑天底下还会有童养女婿这种匪夷所思的事！
唉，看在人家养他那么多年的份上，就算不能当女婿，他也适当照顾一下那位大小姐吧！
content_en:
Gathering a bunch of country children who were too young to work and asking them to memorize poems and songs from an early age and learn basic cultural knowledge was originally just Zhang Shou's initial impulse after he realized that he had to quietly learn about this new world.
He knew that this kind of thing might not be effective, and even the effect of enlightening people's wisdom might be limited, but in the spirit of doing it better than not doing it well, he still did it seriously since he was very free anyway.
But he was able to pick out two teenagers who were very sensitive to mathematics and writing from the peasants who were watching him teach memorizing poems and Jiujiu songs. Among them, Deng Xiaodai had the means to take the civil service examination, and Qi Liang, who had a "family background", passed the county examination in one try. It was a pure surprise.
Therefore, since Miss Zhu did not disturb his class, he did not pay attention to her who was outside listening or eavesdropping.
After giving instructions to Deng Xiaodai, he began to talk about plane geometry to the two of them - even though these two people may never have the opportunity to use plane geometry in their lives, he always felt that if mathematical logic is well cultivated, people will benefit from it throughout their lives.
Of course, Miss Zhu outside would be confused and confused, so he had nothing to do with it.
As expected, Zhu Ying stuck her head out as she listened. However, when she found that Zhang Shou was standing in front of a white wall with his back to her, writing and drawing on a white wall with a cotton thread dipped in water, after a while, Miss Zhu was completely dizzy. Not to mention, Zhang Shou was drawing pictures and dictating the questions, but she didn't understand at all!
Especially when Zhang Shou used cotton thread dipped in water to draw straight lines, and a brush tied at the end to draw circles, and various drawings. Those shapes were extremely complicated and would disappear with the water stains after a while. She was even more dizzy, and she couldn't help but admire the two rural farmers sitting below. You know, Zhang Shou only said it once. How good is his memory to remember it?
Soon, she discovered another problem that she hadn't noticed - Zhang Shou was drawing with his left hand! Thinking of the poor handwriting in the calligraphy books on the bookshelf, she finally realized, feeling that she understood why he, who was so elegant, could not write well.
Left-handed swordsmanship is easy to practice, but writing with your left hand must be difficult!
She was distracted for a while, and when she came back to her senses, she saw two young men sitting on small stools, each with a wooden sandbox in their lap, writing and drawing with wooden sticks. Only then did she realize that they were copying questions in this way. When she saw the two of them thinking hard, as if they were solving a problem, she finally couldn't help but cough slightly.
However, although Zhang Shou turned around and looked towards the door, his reaction made her very angry. Instead of coming out to answer her questions, he put his index finger on his lips and made a silencing gesture to her.
At this moment, she couldn't bear it anymore. She glared at him bitterly and turned away.
It was like this last night at dinner, and it's still like this this morning. When Deng Xiaodai, who had just been admitted as a junior official, went to inquire about the inside story of the marriage certificate, Zhang Shou also used the excuse that he was so frightened that he couldn't sleep after hearing about the marriage. Now he even dislikes her for being too noisy!
"It's just a few questions. Just write them down clearly in black and white and pass them out. There's no need to be so mysterious...ah!"
The more Zhu Ying thought about it, the angrier she felt. She couldn't help but complain. A person jumped out in front of Leng Buding, and she couldn't help being startled. When she found out it was Ah Liu, she realized that not only had she gone and returned, but she was also eavesdropping on Zhang Shou's class at the door, and she suddenly blushed.
She was relieved when she saw Ah Liu making way without saying a word. Although she used to dislike this guy for being taciturn, now it seems that it is really a good thing. At least she is not so embarrassed now!
But she had only taken two steps when she heard Ah Liu say something meaningless from behind: "Paper and pen are very expensive."
Although Miss Zhu didn't know Ah Liu as well as Zhang Shou, she suddenly understood that her complaint just now was heard by this taciturn servant. Growing up in a wealthy family, she naturally didn't know how much pen and paper cost, but thinking about the scene she had just walked from the village, she could also guess that this price would be unaffordable for ordinary farmers.
But she was so angry that she couldn't hold it back: "Can't Ah Shou buy pen and paper to give to them?"
She regretted it as soon as she said it, but it was too late to take it back now.
After all, from the few words she heard before, she could know that Deng Xiaodai, who had passed the junior official examination before, had already thanked Zhang Shou profusely. How could he complain that Zhang Shou had not given them pen and paper for free?
"The young master only has five hundred cash per month, so he buys grain, rice and meat to support their family. Otherwise, their family will not let them work less and eat for free. Qi Liang also owes a lot of debt and almost sold the land. The young master taught him arithmetic while helping him hire people to take care of several acres of cotton fields. In the past three years, he has been able to slowly pay off a little bit of the debt."
This time, Ah Liu rarely spoke more: "Moreover, the young master said that it is better to teach a man how to fish than to teach him how to fish. To save the poor, you can only rely on yourself to save the poor."
Zhu Ying couldn't help being speechless. Especially when she thought about how the fine wolf hairs at home were thrown away casually, and a basket of writing paper was often thrown out a day. She had always been accustomed to it in the past, but now that she thought about it, she couldn't help but feel a little uncomfortable.
This was the first time for her to get to know the poor and the rich at such a close distance.
She didn't speak anymore, just walked forward in silence, and another question came to her mind unknowingly.
Zhang Shou just mentioned that one can memorize the Four Books and Five Classics by heart. Is this true? Who is the old gentleman who quietly teaches him history and arithmetic? How good is Zhang Shou's knowledge? He can teach a student who passed the county examination besides Ling Shi!
In the temporary school building that was converted from the house left by Qi Liang's father, Zhang Shou, who was watching Deng Xiaodai and Qi Liang meditate on solving geometry problems, folded his hands and wondered why Zhu Ying left and returned.
To be fair, this stunningly beautiful daughter actually has a pretty good personality, and can even be called reasonable, and is not the most common kind of arrogant daughter. The first impression Zhu Ying left on him was even better, and he also knew that the first impression he...or his face must have left on Zhu Ying must also be a good one. However, there is a natural chasm between them.
If they are from the wrong family, they are not of the same class! There is definitely something wrong with the so-called engagement!
Therefore, before Miss Zhu's interest in him passes, maybe someone will come to pick her up from Zhao Guogong's mansion today!
Zhang Shouzheng was distracted when he suddenly caught a glimpse of Deng Xiaodai scratching his head and scratching his head, struggling to the point of biting the wooden stick in his hand. He clearly couldn't solve this geometric problem that required two auxiliary lines to solve, so he raised the corner of his mouth with a smile.
When someone looked up as if asking for help, he hooked his index finger and walked out. After leaving the house and waiting for a while, he saw Deng Xiaodai following him out on tiptoe.
"Sir, can you give me a hint?"
"Haha, you kid just likes to compete with Qi Liang!" Why didn't Zhang Shou know what this kid was thinking? He smiled and asked, "Doing questions is different from writing an article. You need to change your mind. If you go around a few times, maybe you can master it."
"It's not that easy." Deng Xiaodai made a bitter look on his face, not at all as proud as when he claimed to have solved the three arithmetic questions asked by the officials in Shuntian Prefecture. Seeing Zhang Shou but smiling, he suddenly thought of the news his uncle had told him. After much hesitation, he finally said hesitantly, "Little sir, there is something I have thought about and decided to tell you."
He took a deep breath, and then lowered his voice and said: "When my uncle took me into the house for the first time, I deliberately pretended to be curious about our village and flipped through our fish scale book. Young sir, all the fields around here are recorded under the name of a person named Zhu. Could it be that your mother was deceived and left the fields with someone? This is not possible. Without the land deed, you will suffer a big loss!"
If Zhu Gongquan had previously revealed that the Zhang family was basically supported by Zhao Guogong, and then when he saw his mother Wu's reaction, Zhang Shou had already felt that this was most likely true, then now that Deng Xiaodai had confirmed it, he no longer had any luck.
This is also his fault. Just because he once asked the tenants around him about the situation, he believed it to be true, and did not consider the unbelievable thing that there would be a child-raised son-in-law in the world!
Alas, considering that they have raised him for so many years, even if he cannot be a son-in-law, he should take proper care of the eldest lady!
title_en: Chapter 11 Falling flowers are intentional but flowing water is ruthless Chapter 12 There is no clear sky but there is sunshine
